title: Concrete finite trace and inverse-projection counit on a projective-line presentation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $N\in\mathbf N$ kill $A$, and let $t$ and $d$ be normalized finite-line pullback comparisons and projective-line splittings [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Let $q:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with an isomorphism $e:X\cong\mathbf P^1_Y$ over $Y$ and with $N$ invertible on $Y$. Transport the trace $d_Y^{-1}$ followed by the second biproduct projection to a trace $\tau_q:Rq_*A_X(1)[2]\to A_Y$, using derived direct-image composition and the adjunction unit along $e$. If $A$ is finite and $q$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable], construct $\varepsilon_q:Rq_!(q^*(-)\otimes_A^L A_X(1)[2])\to\mathrm{id}$ by proper coincidence, inverse ordered projection and tensor trace [def-asd-ordinary-finite-trace-counit]. For a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product], construct $g^{\prime *}(q^*K\otimes_A^L A_X(1)[2])\cong q^{\prime *}g^*K\otimes_A^L A_{X\prime}(1)[2]$ by tensor pullback, inverse-image composition and $t$. These are concrete maps on the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]; no adjunction assertion enters the construction.

source.place: Explicit trace and counit formula; transport between projective-line presentations.

proof.text: The proper torsion projection formula makes each component of the ordered projection invertible; its two tensor symmetries are isomorphisms. Thus the ordered natural transformation is invertible.

Use the adjunction unit along the presentation isomorphism and the normalized line pullback to identify its direct image with the standard line; invert this identification, compose with the standard trace, and use direct-image composition. Compose proper coincidence, inverse projection and tensor trace to construct the counit. Tensor pullback and the square isomorphism construct the comparison.
